plain: Showing scorn for what one sees as beneath oneself

webster.text: Full of disdain; as disdainful soul.

more.text: Expressing disdain; as a disdainful look.

example.quote: The Tiers Etat (as they were then called) disowned any knowledge of artificial orders and artificial privileges; and they were not only resolute on this point, but somewhat disdainful.
example.cite: Thomas Paine, Rights of Man, Parts One and Two (London, 1791-92)
